items.zh: v4.0 正式版发布，之后应用内会自动更新
items.en: v4.0 is now a stable release; future versions update automatically in the app

items.zh: 修复 macOS 上更新或改配置目录后重启，窗口不在最前面
items.en: Fixed the window opening behind other apps after an update or config-directory restart on macOS

items.zh: 修复用量页窗口较窄时，请求日志的速度列被挤出视野
items.en: Fixed the request log's speed column being pushed out of view in a narrow window
